description: Follows Jane’s education, employment, relationships, and return, examining autonomy, dependency, narrative authority, and colonial silences. Covers Gateshead and the Red Room; Lowood, Helen, and Miss Temple; Thornfield and Its Secrets; St. John, Ferndean, and the Ending.
